plain.li: Back in a moment.
[give] This is for {OTHER_nameDef}.
[give] I'll take it over myself.
[burn] Out to the yard with this.
[fetch] I'll go and get it.

blunt.li: [burn] Nobody touches this. It's going on the fire.

plain.li: There.
[give] For you, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[give] I made it for you. Don't make a fuss.
[give] It's yours now.
[burn] That's the end of that.
[burn] Stand back, it'll catch quick.
[fetch] There. That can go on the shelf.

warm.li: [give] I've wanted to give you this for a while.

cheerful.li: [give] Go on, open it. Well, look at it.

gloomy.li: [give] It's not much. It's what I had in me.

plain.li: [give] Took {NAME} over to {OTHER_nameDef} myself and set it down. {OTHER_nameDef} looked at it a long time before saying anything.
[give] Gave {OTHER_nameDef} what I'd made. I didn't stay to watch {OTHER_objective} look at it.
[burn] Carried the stuff out to the yard and burned it. It smelled sweet for a while, then just like smoke.
[fetch] Collected {NAME} from our visitor and brought it in. It's lovely work.

warm.li: [give] {OTHER_nameDef} held it in both hands. I'm glad I made it.

gloomy.li: [give] I gave it to {OTHER_nameDef}. It looked smaller in the daylight.

plain.li: [give] Meant to take it to {OTHER_nameDef} myself. The day got away from me, and someone else set it down by {OTHER_objective}.
[burn] It was meant to go on the fire in the yard. It got burned without me in the end.

gloomy.li: [give] I never gave it to {OTHER_nameDef} myself. That was the whole point.

plain.li: I'll come to each of you. Don't go far.
[outdoors] Soup's coming round.

warm.li: It won't take long, I promise.
[outdoors] Hot soup for whoever's out in the cold.

blunt.li: Stay where you are. I'll find you.

gloomy.li: Right. One at a time, then.

plain.li: Your turn, {OTHER_nameDef}.
Hold still a moment.
[outdoors] Here, mind, it's hot.
[outdoors] Bowl, {OTHER_nameDef}. Drink it while it's warm.

warm.li: [outdoors] Warm your hands on that first.

gloomy.li: [outdoors] It was hot when I left the kitchen.

plain.li: Went round to everyone today, one at a time. My feet ache.
[outdoors] Took the soup pot out to everyone working in the cold. Came back with it empty and my hands frozen.

warm.li: Saw every one of them, and every one of them is all right. That's a good day.

cheerful.li: [outdoors] Everybody wanted seconds. There were no seconds.

gloomy.li: Walked the whole colony twice over. Nobody thanked me, but nobody complained either.

plain.li: Meant to go round to everyone. There was never a quiet moment for it.
[outdoors] The soup went cold in the pot. Nobody was outside long enough to give it to.
Gloves on. Let's get it done.
[pyre] Out past the gate with them. We'll build the pyre there.
[treeline] To the tree line. Leave them where the trees start.
[graves] We'll dig them a grave each, out past the wall.
[trench] One long trench outside the wall. Bring the shovels.
[crematorium] To the crematorium, one at a time.

blunt.li: One each. Don't look at the faces.

gloomy.li: This is the part nobody tells you about.

plain.li: Heavier than you'd think.
Mind the feet.
[pyre] Lay this one on the pile.
[treeline] Leave it here.
[graves] Gently, into the ground.
[trench] Lay this one next to the last.
[crematorium] Another one for the fire.
[pyre] Carried the raiders out past the gate and stacked them for the pyre. I washed my hands three times after.
[treeline] Dragged the raiders' bodies out to the tree line and left them there for whatever comes out of the woods.
[graves] We dug the raiders a grave each outside the wall. My back will remember it longer than I'll remember their faces.
[trench] One long trench outside the wall, and all of the raiders in it. Nobody said much while we filled it in.
[crematorium] Carried the raiders into the crematorium one at a time. I don't want to think about the smell.

warm.li: We carried them out as gently as we could. They came here to kill us. They were still people.

blunt.li: Hauled the dead out. Not doing that again if I can help it.

gloomy.li: I'll be smelling it for days.

cold.li: The bodies are out of the colony. That was the task.

plain.li: We were meant to carry the raiders out. It never got done, and the bodies are still lying there.

blunt.li: Nobody moved the bodies. Somebody should.

plain.li: I've something to tell all of you.
Let me get through it before anyone says anything.
This isn't easy. Bear with me.

warm.li: I'd rather you heard it from me.

cheerful.li: Everyone comfortable? Good. This might take a minute.

gloomy.li: You might think less of me after this.

cold.li: There is something you should know.
